# Code of Conduct

Everyone is welcome to participate in Kicker. Treat other people with respect regardless of their background, identity, disability, language, or experience level.

Give constructive feedback, focus on the work when you disagree, and respect requests to stop unwanted contact. Harassment, discrimination, threats, personal attacks, and sharing someone else's private information without permission are unacceptable.

These standards apply to Kicker's GitHub issues, pull requests, discussions, and other project spaces.

## Reporting and enforcement

Contact a [project maintainer](https://github.com/lechixy) privately if you experience or witness a violation. Include links and enough context for the maintainer to review the report. You can also use GitHub's built-in report option for abusive content or accounts. Keep sensitive details out of public issues and comments.

Maintainers will limit access to reports to the people who need them to respond. Depending on the situation, maintainers may remove content, issue a warning, or restrict participation. Retaliation against anyone who reports a concern or helps review it violates this code of conduct.
